title: Can't compete with the Ninja for smoothies & older Black & Decker is better on ice
text:
Can't compete with the Ninja for smoothies & older Black & Decker is better on ice. Color me unimpressed by this blender. Technically, it works, but not well and not as well as my two year old Black & Decker XL Blast blender. I do like the glass jar and the measurements marked on it and I like the gold color. I do not like the way it works.

Case in point - the booklet specifically mentions making whipped cream. Now, as a sensible cook who KNOWS how to make real whipped cream (and I do often), I understand that more than 90 seconds in any blender will produce a curdled disaster instead of whipped cream. You make whipped cream with a hand mixer. But I tried with the blender because the book said I could. Yep...67 seconds to a gross curdled mess. See the photos.

Ice. I wanted to make a single frozen drink. Six regular square ice cubes were too much for this blender. It left two of the cubes completely whole and one broken in half. The other three were nicely crushed/pulverized and suitable for a margarita etc. Mind you, to get to that point took almost 3 full minutes including stopping to scrape the ice down with a spatula and mix it by hand. When I emptied the jar there was a thick layer of ice stuck under the blades.

Mixing just light, soft things is fine. Yogurt, juice, and a little canned pineapple mix easily - you will have to pull some of the pineapple out from under the blades. Honestly, I prefer my Nutri Ninja for smoothies and my old XL Blast blender for bigger blending jobs.

product_metadata.title: BLACK+DECKER BL1130SG FusionBlade Blender with 6-Cup Glass Jar, 12-Speed Settings, Silver Blender
features: 12 Speeds + Pulse - Find the perfect blending power for everything from sauces to smoothies with 12 speed settings. The pulse function lets you create the perfect consistency
6-cup Glass Jar - The durable 6-cup (48oz.) glass jar is designed to increase blending efficiency. Its thick walls allow for safe blending of hot soups and more
550W Power - Tough blending is no match for the powerful motor inside this blender

FusionBlade - The stainless steel FusionBlade is designed to quickly crush ice and evenly blend soups and smoothies. The shape of the jar helps to create a constant flow straight to the blade so food is blended as quickly as possible
Dishwasher-Safe Parts - All removable parts are dishwasher-safe for fast and easy cleanup
Slip-Resistant Rubber Feet - The powerful blender stays in place thanks to the strong rubber grips
Cord Storage - The convenient cord wrap within the unit makes for easy storage
1-oz. Lid Insert - The clear lid insert lets you drizzle in oil or other liquids during blending, and it doubles as a 1-oz. measuring cup for making blended mixed drinks
description: The new BLACK+DECKER FusionBlade Blender combines advanced blade technology with innovative jar geometry to take care of all your blending needs. From mixing and chopping to blending and pureeing, the 12 speeds of the powerful 550W motor get the job done quickly. Dishwasher-safe removable parts make cleanup fast and easy.
